summary: This note is a short encyclopedic entry on Johannes Tauler, a German mystic, Catholic preacher and theologian of the 14th century. It describes him as a Dominican and a disciple of Meister Eckhart, and as one of the most important Rhineland mystics. It also notes his promotion of a neo-platonist dimension in the Dominican spirituality of his time.
one_line: Johannes Tauler was a 14th-century German Dominican mystic, preacher and theologian, a disciple of Meister Eckhart and a leading Rhineland mystic.
key_facts: Johannes Tauler OP was born around 1300 and died on 16 June 1361.
Johannes Tauler was a German mystic, a Catholic preacher and a theologian.
Johannes Tauler was a disciple of Meister Eckhart.
Johannes Tauler belonged to the Dominican order.
Johannes Tauler was known as one of the most important Rhineland mystics.
Johannes Tauler promoted a certain neo-platonist dimension in the Dominican spirituality of his time.
